props.name: maxTime

props.name: hourStep

props.name: minuteStep

props.name: secondStep

name: ToastProvider
description: Toast stack (viewport) rendering the toasts of the `toast()` API.

props.name: position
props.description: Where the toasts are stacked

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum number of toasts shown at once; when exceeded the oldest close first

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Pauses the auto-close timer while a toast is hovered or focused

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label of the toast region (used as is; the default one includes the hotkey)

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the close buttons

props.name: hotkey

props.name: noPauseOnHover

events.name: minerva-after-close

name: Toolbar
description: Wrapping row of related controls (role="group").

props.name: wrap
props.description: Wraps controls onto multiple lines; `false` keeps one bounded row

props.name: density
props.description: Gap between controls: `default` (space-3) or `compact` (space-1, with centered direct-child vertical dividers)

props.name: asChild

props.name: nowrap

name: Tooltip
description: Hover / focus tooltip, dismissable with Escape and hoverable.

props.name: content
props.description: Content displayed inside the tooltip

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the tooltip is shown (controlled; pair with onOpenChange)

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state (uncontrolled)

props.name: placement
props.description: Placement relative to the trigger

props.name: color
props.description: Semantic color of the tooltip. With the `glass` variant the color only tints the border (neutral keeps the plain frosted surface)

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style: `solid` (filled; neutral is the inverted contrasting surface), `subtle` (tinted surface with a border) or `glass` (frosted elevated surface)

props.name: shape
props.description: Shape of the tooltip

props.name: animation
props.description: Show / hide animation

props.name: enterDelay
props.description: Delay before showing on hover, in milliseconds

props.name: leaveDelay
props.description: Delay before hiding on mouse leave, in milliseconds

props.name: offset
props.description: Offset as [x, y] in pixels. For top/bottom placements `y` is the gap to the trigger and `x` shifts along it; for left/right placements `x` is the gap and `y` shifts along it. Without it the tooltip sits 8px away.

props.name: followCursor
props.description: Makes the tooltip follow the mouse cursor

props.name: zIndex
props.description: z-index of the tooltip

props.name: arrow
props.description: Shows an arrow pointing at the trigger

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the tooltip

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label of the tooltip element

props.name: asChild
props.description: Attaches the hover / focus handlers, the ref and `className` directly to the single child element instead of wrapping it in a `<div>` (keeps flex and grid layouts intact). The child must accept a `ref`.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Additional class name of the tooltip (floating) element. To customize the colors, set the `--tooltip-bg` (background, gradients allowed) and `--tooltip-color` (text) custom properties on it

props.name: contentRef
props.description: Ref to the tooltip (floating) element, set while it is shown

events.name: minerva-open-change
events.description: Hover, focus, blur, pointer leave or Escape asked to open / close (`detail: { open }`); cancelable: `preventDefault()` keeps the current state

events.name: close
events.description: Called when the tooltip closes from mouse leave, blur or Escape

slots.name: default
slots.description: The trigger; prefer a single focusable element (button, link...)

slots.name: content
slots.description: Rich tooltip content (alternative to the `content` attribute)

name: TooltipProvider
description: Shared default delays for the tooltips inside.

props.name: enterDelay
props.description: Default delay before showing on hover, in milliseconds, for every Tooltip inside that does not set `enterDelay`

props.name: leaveDelay
props.description: Default delay before hiding on mouse leave, in milliseconds, for every Tooltip inside that does not set `leaveDelay`

props.name: skipDelay
props.description: When another tooltip of the provider closed less than this many milliseconds ago, the next one opens without waiting for its enter delay

name: Upload

props.name: label

props.name: value

props.name: accept
props.description: Accepted file types, as for <input accept> (".pdf", "image/*", "application/json"...)

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allows selecting several files

props.name: replace
props.description: Single-file mode: lets a new file replace the listed one (the existing file does not count toward maxCount)

props.name: maxCount
props.description: Maximum number of files, including the listed ones

props.name: maxSize

props.name: loading
props.description: Busy state: blocks new selections and retries (removal stays possible) and sets aria-busy

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables selection, retry and removal

props.name: labels

props.name: removable

props.name: retryable
props.description: Shows a retry button on failed items

props.name: name

props.name: required
props.description: The control must have a value for the form to be submitted

props.name: items
props.description: Listed files with their transfer state

props.name: texts

events.name: change

events.name: minerva-files-selected
events.description: Valid files were picked or dropped; `detail: { files }`; cancelable (the files are then not listed)

events.name: minerva-change
events.description: The listed files changed through the user; `detail: { value }` (the items)

events.name: minerva-remove
events.description: The remove button of an item was activated; `detail: { item }`; cancelable (keeps the item)

events.name: minerva-retry
events.description: The retry button of a failed item was activated; `detail: { item }`

name: VirtualList
description: Windowed list rendering only the visible rows.

props.name: items
props.description: Items to render

props.name: itemHeight
props.description: Fixed row height in pixels; measured from the first item when omitted

props.name: itemPadding
props.description: Padding of each row in pixels

props.name: overscan
props.description: Number of rows rendered above and below the visible area

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Maximum height of the scroll container in pixels

props.name: renderItem
props.description: Renders the content of one row

props.name: loadMoreThreshold

props.name: highPerformance
props.description: Batches scroll updates with requestAnimationFrame and requestIdleCallback

props.name: loading

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the list

props.name: clickable
props.description: Rows are clickable: focusable, pointer cursor, `minerva-item-click`

events.name: minerva-item-click

events.name: minerva-load-more
events.description: The list was scrolled within `load-more-threshold` px of the bottom

name: VStack
description: Vertical stack.

props.name: separator

props.name: as
props.description: Element or component to render

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between items: numbers and numeric strings select spacing tokens (`2` -> `var(--space-2)`), other strings are CSS values. No gap when omitted.

props.name: wrap
